base.description: Ground set alight by Scarlet Dragons and Ardent Dragons: enemies that walk in or act while standing on it take Fire damage.
The trail of fire left by Ardent Dragons: enemies that walk in or act while standing on it take Fire damage.

none.description:
{Rune of Balance}

Moves your Rune of Balance to the target hex (each side has only one rune; at the start of combat it is already placed in front of the Rune Clerics and Rune Hierarchs). Your units on the rune hex and the ring around it share the attack damage they take. Unlimited uses; once the rune has been used up by “Rune Teleport”, it cannot be placed again.

{Rune Teleport}

Teleports into the aura of your Rune of Balance (click a hex in the aura; if it is occupied, it lands on the nearest free hex). The rune vanishes and its aura passes to the Rune Hierarch until the end of the battle: it and the allies in the ring around it share the attack damage they take.

{Magma Pond}

Creates a Magma Pond under itself and in the ring around it, lasting until the end of the next round. Units (friend or foe) standing in the pond at the start of each round, or walking into it, take 12×Magma Elemental count Fire damage (10 in the original, scaled by level 5 damage), at most once per unit per round. Unlimited uses.

none.description:
{Thorns}

Can be cast only once per battle. Lays thorns on the target hex, the hex east of it and the two hexes below (2×2) for 3 rounds. Enemies in the thorns get Speed -3 (on casting and at the start of each round, until the start of the next round); enemies that start moving from the thorns, or stop in them after moving, take 9×Druid Elder count Earth damage (10 in the original, scaled by level 4 damage), at most once per unit per round, and moving cannot kill the whole stack.

{Leaf Daggers}

Can be cast only once per battle. Once prepared, its next shot this turn pierces in a straight line to the edge of the battlefield; each enemy stack on the line takes the damage of one normal shot, ignoring the target's Defense, the range penalty and the wall penalty (it can target an empty hex). Cannot be used while an enemy is adjacent. (Cast on itself; does not end the turn. Once prepared, click a target to shoot; that shot is a normal shot, and the preparation is wasted if it does not shoot this round. If an enemy attacks it before it shoots, or the round ends, this use does not count.)

none.description:
{Rune of Fortune (H7)}

Summons a Fortune Stone on the target empty hex. Its aura covers hexes within 1 hex of the stone (about 3×3): allies get +1 Luck, enemies -1 Luck.
Each side has only one stone of each rune; casting it again moves the stone to the target hex.
Once per battle the stone can be triggered (cast on its turn): allied stacks in the aura get a shield that absorbs 6 + 4×hero level damage (lasts the whole battle; absorbs both attacks and actively cast damage spells).
Rune Stones cannot move, attack, be attacked or be affected by spells, do not count as battle troops, and vanish after combat.

The aura improves with the Runes skill (None/Basic ×1, Advanced ×2, Expert ×3 with a 2-hex radius). Costs no Spell Points.

base.description:
{Lightning Burst (H7)}

Air damage dealt by a Lightning Burst discharge (triggered by the Lightning Burst spell).

expert.description:
{Expert Gust of Wind (H7)}

A gust of wind pushes the chosen stack away from the caster (in a straight line first, or diagonally if it cannot move straight or the diagonal goes farther; it stops at stacks, obstacles, walls or the battlefield edge; war machines cannot be pushed).

Pushed 4 hexes straight or 2 hexes diagonally.
Also deals Air damage: 100 + 20×Spell Power (H7: 20×M to 200+20×M).

none.description:
{Lightning Reflexes (H7)}

The chosen allied stack strikes one extra time in melee (after the enemy's retaliation); the extra strike has an Attack modifier of (1.0×Spell Power - 30), for 1 round.

basic.description:
{Basic Lightning Reflexes (H7)}

The chosen allied stack strikes one extra time in melee (after the enemy's retaliation); the extra strike has an Attack modifier of (1.5×Spell Power - 30), for 1 round.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Lightning Reflexes (H7)}

The chosen allied stack strikes one extra time in melee (after the enemy's retaliation); the extra strike has an Attack modifier of (1.5×Spell Power - 30), for 2 rounds.

expert.description:
{Expert Time Control (H7)}

Increases the Speed of your stacks and reduces the Speed of enemy stacks for 3 rounds (Initiative ±15 in H7, converted to Speed ±5 by this mod's conversion). The slow has no effect on stacks immune to negative effects or with Prime Immunity.
The area expands to the center and the adjacent ring (H7: 4×4); stacks in it are hasted or slowed according to their side.

Speed ±5

{Expert Stone Skin (H7)}

Increases the Defense of the target allied stack.

Defense +(8 + 1.3×Spell Power) (rounded) for 3 rounds.
Expert (with Earth Understanding I): affects the target and all allied stacks within 2 hexes (4×4 area in H7).

{Expert Regeneration (H7)}

The chosen allied stack regenerates Hit Points over time and can resurrect creatures (in H7 it heals on its turn; here at the start of each round). With the Ring of Oblivion it only heals, without resurrecting. No effect on war machines.

For the next 3 rounds, restores 55 + 5×Spell Power Hit Points at the start of each round and can resurrect the stack's fallen creatures (kept after combat).
Expert (with Earth Understanding I): affects the target and all allied stacks within 3 hexes (6×6 area in H7).

{Expert Entangle (H7)}

Reduces the Speed of the target enemy stack (H7 movement points carried over as Speed) and prevents movement-based abilities.

Speed -6 for 3 rounds; during this time it cannot use Charge, Swoop, Pounce or other movement abilities.
Expert (with Earth Understanding II): for 3 rounds, it takes 45 + 25×Spell Power Earth damage after each move (ignores resistance in the H7 original); no effect on creatures that teleport in H7, such as Simurghs and Vampires.

{Expert Poison Spray (H7)}

Poisons the target enemy stack, dealing Earth damage over time (in H7 the damage is taken on its turn; here at the start of each round). The damage is fixed when cast, based on the target's resistances and school reductions.

Takes 80 + 16×Spell Power Earth damage at the start of each round.
Expert (with Earth Understanding II): lasts until the end of combat.

{Expert Rock Spikes (H7)}

All stacks (friend or foe) on the target hex and the ring around it (a cross-shaped area in H7) take Earth damage.

Earth damage: 160 + 32×Spell Power
Expert (with Earth Understanding III): the stack on the target hex takes double damage.

{Expert Earthquake (H7)}

All non-flying stacks on the battlefield (both sides, except arrow towers) take Earth damage. In a siege, each wall section, arrow tower, gate and keep takes 1 point of damage, or 2 if already damaged (H7 doubles damage to damaged defenses).

Deals 80 + 16×Spell Power Earth damage to stacks.
Expert (with Earth Understanding III): enemies take double damage.

{Expert Implosion (H7)}

Single-target damage spell (a Prime spell in H7) that deals a percentage of the target's current total Hit Points as damage; other stacks within 3 hexes of the target (both sides, except war machines) are pulled 1 hex closer. Creatures with Prime Immunity take half damage, are not pulled and suffer no aftershock.

Damage: 5% + 2%×Spell Power of the target's current total Hit Points, max 75%.
Expert (with Prime Understanding III): at the start of the next round the target takes damage again, equal to 3% + 1.5%×Spell Power of its total Hit Points at that time, max 60%.

{Expert Fire Bolt (H7)}

Single-target Fire damage spell (H7 damage is a range; the average is used here).

Fire damage: 60 + 20×Spell Power
Expert (with Fire Understanding I): Burning for 3 rounds: takes 30 + 10×Spell Power Fire damage after its first action each round (average of H7's 10 to 50 + 10×Magic)

{Expert Burning Resolve (H7)}

Raises allies' Morale. H7 Morale points convert at 10 points ≈ 1 VCMI Morale (VCMI Morale is capped at +3).

Morale +(20 + 1.5×Spell Power) ÷ 10 (rounded down), for 3 rounds
Expert (including Fire Understanding I): affects the target and the allies in the ring around it (4×4 in H7)

{Expert Fire Wall (H7)}

Places a vertical Fire Wall 5 hexes long on the target hex (the target hex, two above and two below; hexes occupied by stacks or obstacles are skipped), lasting until the end of this round.

Stacks entering, passing through or standing on the Fire Wall take 56.5 + 26×Spell Power Fire damage (flying stacks are hurt only where they land)
Expert (with Fire Understanding II): stacks passing through are stopped on the wall; damaged stacks also Burn for 3 rounds: 30 + 10×Spell Power Fire damage after their first action each round (average of H7's 10 to 50 + 10×Magic)

{Expert Inner Fire (H7)}

Raises the Attack and Speed of an allied stack (+1 H7 Initiative converted to +1 Speed).

Attack +8 + 1.3×Spell Power (rounded), Speed +5, for 3 rounds
Expert (with Fire Understanding II): affects the target and the allies in the ring around it (H7 4×4)

{Expert Fireball (H7)}

Deals Fire damage to all stacks on the target hex and the ring around it (3×3 in H7), friend or foe (H7 damage is a range; the average is used here).

Fire damage: 84 + 40×Spell Power
Expert (with Fire Understanding III): Burning for 3 rounds: takes 30 + 10×Spell Power Fire damage after its first action each round (average of H7's 10 to 50 + 10×Magic)

{Expert Summon Elemental (H7)}

Summons a random elemental (Air, Earth, Fire, Water, Light or Darkness Elemental; the neutral elementals of H7) to fight for you; it vanishes after combat. Can be cast several times to summon different elementals. Originally a Prime spell.

Summoned: 2 + 0.5×Spell Power (rounded)
Expert (with Prime Understanding III): if the summoned stack is alive at the start of each later round, it gains +4 creatures

{Expert Heal (H7)}

Heals and resurrects the target allied stack (permanently); can also be used to damage enemy Undead. No effect on constructs (non-living and mechanical).

Healing: 30 + 10×Spell Power (can resurrect); deals 90 + 30×Spell Power Light damage to enemy Undead (a random range in H7; the average is used).
Expert (with Light Understanding I): affects all stacks within 2 hexes of the target (4×4 area in H7): allies are healed, enemy Undead are damaged, others are unaffected.

{Expert Sunbeam (H7)}

Fires a beam of sunlight that deals Light damage to the target enemy stack.

Deals 60 + 20×Spell Power Light damage (H7 damage is a range; the average is used here).
Expert (with Light Understanding I): the target's Attack and Defense are each reduced by 0.5×Spell Power (rounded) for 3 rounds.

{Expert Celestial Armor (H7)}

The target ally gains Celestial Armor: damage it takes is absorbed by the armor first, which vanishes after absorbing a set total or after 3 rounds. Attacks (melee, ranged, retaliation) and actively cast damage spells are all absorbed.

Total absorbed: 54 + 14×Spell Power.
Expert (including Light Understanding II): affects the target and all allies within 1 hex (the 3×3 area in H7).

{Expert Cleansing Light (H7)}

Removes negative spells from the target allied stack (all effects left by the same spell are removed together).

Removes 3 random negative spells.
Expert (with Light Understanding II): affects the target and all allied stacks within 2 hexes (4×4 area in H7).

{Expert Retribution (H7)}

When the target allied stack is attacked (melee, ranged or retaliation) and loses Hit Points, the attacker takes Light damage in return, for 3 rounds. Attackers immune to Light are unaffected.

Each reflection deals 81.5 + 18×Spell Power Light damage (rounded; a random range in H7, the average is used), adjusted by the attacker's Light resistance.
Expert (with Light Understanding III): affects the target and all allied stacks within 2 hexes (4×4 area in H7).

{Expert Sunburst (H7)}

Fires beams in six directions from the chosen hex (eight in H7, but hexes allow only six); each beam hits the first enemy stack it meets. Allies do not block the beams; obstacles and walls do. An enemy on the center hex is also hurt.

Each enemy stack hit takes 78 + 26×Spell Power Light damage (H7 damage is a range; the average is used here).
Expert (with Light Understanding III): struck enemies have their Attack and Defense each reduced by 0.5×Spell Power (rounded) for 3 rounds.

{Expert Despair (H7)}

Lowers the Morale of the target enemy stack for 3 rounds.

Morale -(2 + 0.15×Spell Power) (rounded; in H7 it is -(20 + 1.5×Spell Power) points, every 10 points converted to 1), for 3 rounds.
Expert (with Dark Understanding I): affects the target and all enemy stacks within 2 hexes (4×4 area in H7).

{Expert Weakness (H7)}

Reduces the Attack of the target enemy stack for 3 rounds.

Attack -(8 + 1.3×Spell Power) (rounded) for 3 rounds.
Expert (with Dark Understanding I): affects the target and all enemy stacks within 2 hexes (4×4 area in H7).

{Expert Face of Fear (H7)}

For 3 rounds, the target allied stack frightens the enemies it attacks (not retaliations): after a melee attack the target is pushed 2 hexes away from the attacker (only if there is free space behind it; in H7 ranged attacks also frighten), and the struck enemy becomes Feared (Morale reduced for 3 rounds; repeat hits only refresh the duration). Enemies with Mind Immunity or unaffected by Morale cannot be Feared.

Fear: Morale -(1 + 0.08×Spell Power) (rounded, at least 1; in H7 -(10 + 0.8×Spell Power) points), for 3 rounds.
Expert (with Dark Understanding II): the attacked enemy cannot retaliate this round.

{Expert Expunge (H7)}

Removes beneficial spells from the target enemy stack (all effects left by the same spell are removed together).

Removes 3 random beneficial spells.
Expert (with Dark Understanding II): also curses it for 3 rounds: beneficial spells actively cast on it are removed at once (spells cast by attacks are not blocked).

{Expert Agony (H7)}

The target enemy takes Dark damage after each of its actions (attacking, moving, waiting and defending all count) for 3 rounds.

Each time: 84 + 28×Spell Power Dark damage (a random range in H7; the average is used), adjusted by the target's Dark resistance.
Expert (including Dark Understanding III): affects the target and all enemies within 2 hexes (the 4×4 area in H7).

{Expert Shadow Image (H7)}

Summons a mirror image (clone) of the target allied stack next to it. The image vanishes as soon as it takes any damage, but otherwise lasts until the end of combat. Stacks that already have an image, or are images themselves, cannot be copied.

Image count = target count × 5% × Spell Power (rounded, at least 1).
Expert (with Dark Understanding III): within 3 rounds, the image does not vanish the first time it is attacked (spell damage still makes it vanish).

Expert: the struck stack gets -3 Speed for 3 rounds.

{Expert Ice Strike (H7)}

Extra damage: 260 + 13×Spell Power
Expert: struck enemies get -3 Speed for 3 rounds.

Expert: struck stacks get -3 Speed for 3 rounds.

none.description:
{Freezing Orb (H7)}

Summons a one-hex Freezing Orb on the target empty hex (it cannot act or retaliate and counts as a war machine). It lasts until the end of the 2nd round after casting or until destroyed. On landing the orb releases a 3×3 Frost Aura; at the end of each round it then moves, ignoring obstacles, to the farthest empty hex next to an enemy stack and releases it again. The aura deals Water damage to adjacent enemies and gives them -3 Speed for 3 rounds.

Orb Hit Points: 400
Aura damage: 50 + 13×Spell Power

basic.description:
{Basic Freezing Orb (H7)}

Summons a one-hex Freezing Orb on the target empty hex (it cannot act or retaliate and counts as a war machine). It lasts until the end of the 2nd round after casting or until destroyed. On landing the orb releases a 3×3 Frost Aura; at the end of each round it then moves, ignoring obstacles, to the farthest empty hex next to an enemy stack and releases it again. The aura deals Water damage to adjacent enemies and gives them -3 Speed for 3 rounds.

Orb Hit Points: 700
Aura damage: 80 + 18×Spell Power
